Roth.theta_denominators_one_lt_aux✝ {n : ℕ} {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ} (hrlast : 0 < r 0) (hq1 : 0 < Real.log ↑(q 0))
  (hqr : ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) (j : Fin (n + 1)) : 1 < q j

private theorem Roth.theta_denominators_one_lt_aux : ∀ {n : ℕ} {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ},
  0 < r 0 →
    0 < Real.log ↑(q 0) →
      (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) → ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), 1 < q j :=
fun {n} {r q} hrlast hq1 hqr j ↦
  cast (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (Eq.symm Nat.cast_one)) ↑(q j)) Nat.cast_lt._simp_1)
    ((Real.log_pos_iff (Nat.cast_nonneg (q j))).mp
      (pos_of_mul_pos_right
        (LT.lt.trans_le
          (mul_pos
            (cast (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) ↑(r 0)) Nat.cast_lt._simp_1))
              hrlast)
            hq1)
          (hqr j))
        (Nat.cast_nonneg (r j))))
